name: l_side
js: const sb=window.sandbox; document.getElementById('hud').hidden=true; const net=sb.world.trapar.braids.net; const r=sb.rider; const f=new Float64Array(3); net.fields(r.pos.x,r.pos.z,f); sb.camOverride=(c)=>{c.position.set(r.pos.x-1500,(f[0]+f[1])/2+80,r.pos.z-1500);c.up.set(0,1,0);c.lookAt(r.pos.x+800,(f[1]+f[2])/2-60,r.pos.z+800);c.fov=75;c.updateProjectionMatrix();}

name: l_spiral
js: const sb=window.sandbox; const net=sb.world.trapar.braids.net; const r=sb.rider; const bs=net.bandsIn(r.pos.x-4000,r.pos.x+4000,r.pos.z-4000,r.pos.z+4000,r.pos.x,r.pos.z,4500).filter(b=>b.kind==='spiral up'); const b=bs[0]; window._b=b&&{x:b.x[b.n>>1],y:b.y[b.n>>1],z:b.z[b.n>>1],n:bs.length}; if(b){const m=b.n>>1, x=b.x[m], z=b.z[m], y0=b.y[0], y1=b.y[b.n-1]; sb.camOverride=(c)=>{c.position.set(x-650,(y0+y1)/2+40,z-650);c.up.set(0,1,0);c.lookAt(x,(y0+y1)/2,z);c.fov=70;c.updateProjectionMatrix();};}

name: l_updraft
js: const sb=window.sandbox; const net=sb.world.trapar.braids.net; const r=sb.rider; const bs=net.bandsIn(r.pos.x-4000,r.pos.x+4000,r.pos.z-4000,r.pos.z+4000,r.pos.x,r.pos.z,4500).filter(b=>b.kind==='updraft'); const b=bs[0]; if(b){const m=b.n>>1, x=b.x[m], z=b.z[m], y=b.y[m]; const dx=b.x[b.n-1]-b.x[0], dz=b.z[b.n-1]-b.z[0], l=Math.hypot(dx,dz); sb.camOverride=(c)=>{c.position.set(x-dz/l*700,y+60,z+dx/l*700);c.up.set(0,1,0);c.lookAt(x,y,z);c.fov=75;c.updateProjectionMatrix();};}

name: l_up
js: const sb=window.sandbox; const r=sb.rider; const net=sb.world.trapar.braids.net; const f=new Float64Array(3); net.fields(r.pos.x,r.pos.z,f); sb.camOverride=(c)=>{c.position.set(r.pos.x+300,f[0]+40,r.pos.z+300);c.up.set(0,1,0);c.lookAt(r.pos.x+900,f[2],r.pos.z+1400);c.fov=80;c.updateProjectionMatrix();}
